m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read CREW_CONTEXT.md, GLOSSARY.md, the g1 handoff, engine-config.json, and probe the input details.json + calibration artifact shape. Verify handoff completeness. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + glossary + handoff loaded; handoff complete; input data shape understood (12 modules, 4 race_start, 24 event rows 2025, entity_count all None, per-module fitted alpha/beta in artifact)
postconditions.satisfied_by: context+glossary+handoff loaded; data shape confirmed: 12 modules/4 race_start/24 2025-event rows/entity_count all None/per-module fitted alpha-beta in artifact; pearson matches engine embedded corr

m1-skeleton.title: Harness skeleton: load, stats helpers, --selftest
m1-skeleton.imperative: Create sigma_significance_probe.py with: JSON loader; numpy/scipy-optional stats helpers (pearson, Fisher-z CI, t-based p-value, r_crit(n), seeded bootstrap percentile CI) that degrade to stdlib math/random/statistics; and a --selftest flag validating r_crit and Fisher-z on a known case. Must exit 0 on --selftest.

postconditions.statement: --selftest passes (known-case r_crit and Fisher-z within tolerance)

m2-significance.title: Part (a): per-module sigma_corr significance
m2-significance.imperative: For all 12 modules compute sigma_corr=pearson(sigma_pi_trace, rank_mae_vs_retro_bt) over the 24 event rows; report point estimate, bootstrap percentile 95% CI, Fisher-z 95% CI, two-sided p vs rho=0, significant/indistinguishable verdict. Cross-check vs embedded engine corr. Print r_crit(n=24, alpha=0.05). Emit compact stdout table; highlight the 4 race_start modules.

postconditions.statement: stdout shows per-module sigma_corr + both CIs + p + verdict for all 12 (4 race_start flagged) and r_crit(n=24); my pearson matches embedded engine corr

constraints: statistically honest: report indistinguishable-from-0 when that is the truth

m3-level-coverage.title: Part (b): per-phase level/flatness + mis-level verdict
m3-level-coverage.imperative: Using per-module fitted alpha,beta from the uncertainty_calibration artifact (primary) and noting the task-level identity alpha=1,beta=0 caveat (insufficient_data), compute calibrated_sigma=alpha*sigma_pi_trace+beta*effective_dof per event with effective_dof=max(entity_count-1,1)=1 (entity_count is None -> fall back to 1, SAY SO). Report per-phase (quali/race/race_start) mean(calibrated_sigma) vs mean(realized rank_mae_vs_retro_bt) and ratio, plus CV(sigma) vs CV(error). End with explicit verdict: race_start mis-leveled (too high and/or too flat) vs quali/race, or coverage-aligned.

postconditions.statement: stdout shows per-phase level/flatness summary + entity_count=None fallback note + explicit race_start mis-level-vs-coverage-aligned verdict

constraints: do not manufacture a mis-level the numbers do not support

m4-evidence-json.title: Write machine-readable g1_evidence.json
m4-evidence-json.imperative: Write .agent-work/evo-prediction-ceiling/evidence/g1_evidence.json with per-module sigma_corr stats, r_crit, per-phase level/flatness numbers, verdicts, provenance (source paths, seed, lib availability, entity_count fallback).

postconditions.statement: g1_evidence.json exists and is valid JSON with required keys

check.command: py -c "import json;d=json.load(open('.agent-work/evo-prediction-ceiling/evidence/g1_evidence.json',encoding='utf-8'));assert 'per_module' in d and 'r_crit' in d and 'per_phase' in d and 'verdicts' in d;print('OK keys',sorted(d.keys()))"

payload.cmd: py -c "import json;d=json.load(open('.agent-work/evo-prediction-ceiling/evidence/g1_evidence.json',encoding='utf-8'));assert 'per_module' in d and 'r_crit' in d and 'per_phase' in d and 'verdicts' in d;print('OK keys',sorted(d.keys()))"

m5-verify.title: Final verification: clean run exits 0
m5-verify.imperative: Run the exact verification command from the handoff and confirm exit 0 with full table + verdicts + r_crit + g1_evidence.json present. Capture stdout for IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

postconditions.statement: py .agent-work/evo-prediction-ceiling/evidence/sigma_significance_probe.py exits 0 and prints table + verdicts + r_crit
